usage_records_attempt_schema_check.name: usage_records_attempt_schema_check
usage_records_attempt_schema_check.value: "usage_records"."attempt_schema_version" IN (1, 2) AND ("usage_records"."attempt_schema_version" = 1 OR "usage_records"."model_request_id" IS NOT NULL)

usage_records_token_check.name: usage_records_token_check
usage_records_token_check.value: "usage_records"."prompt_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_records"."cached_prompt_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_records"."cache_write_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_records"."completion_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_records"."reasoning_tokens" >= 0 AND "usage_records"."reasoning_tokens" <= "usage_records"."completion_tokens" AND "usage_records"."total_tokens" = "usage_records"."prompt_tokens" + "usage_records"."cached_prompt_tokens" + "usage_records"."cache_write_tokens" + "usage_records"."completion_tokens"

capacity_leases_resource_check.name: capacity_leases_resource_check
capacity_leases_resource_check.value: "capacity_leases"."memory_mb" >= 0 AND "capacity_leases"."container_slots" >= 0 AND ("capacity_leases"."cpu_millis" IS NULL OR "capacity_leases"."cpu_millis" > 0) AND ("capacity_leases"."pid_limit" IS NULL OR "capacity_leases"."pid_limit" > 0)

finding_disposition_verifications_outcom.name: finding_disposition_verifications_outcome_disposition_check
finding_disposition_verifications_outcom.value: "finding_disposition_verifications"."outcome" IS NULL OR ("finding_disposition_verifications"."requested_state" = 'resolved' AND "finding_disposition_verifications"."outcome" IN ('fixed', 'still_present', 'inconclusive')) OR ("finding_disposition_verifications"."requested_state" = 'dismissed' AND "finding_disposition_verifications"."outcome" IN ('false_positive', 'validated', 'inconclusive'))

runners_ownership_check.name: runners_ownership_check
runners_ownership_check.value:
(
        ("runners"."ownership" = 'platform' AND "runners"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "runners"."type" = 'cloud')
        OR
        ("runners"."ownership" = 'organization' AND "runners"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "runners"."type" = 'private')
      )

runners_capacity_values_check.name: runners_capacity_values_check
runners_capacity_values_check.value:
(
        ("runners"."detected_memory_mb" IS NULL OR "runners"."detected_memory_mb" > 0)
        AND ("runners"."detected_container_slots" IS NULL OR "runners"."detected_container_slots" > 0)
        AND ("runners"."derived_active_run_limit" IS NULL OR "runners"."derived_active_run_limit" > 0)
      )

runs_code_review_identity_check.name: runs_code_review_identity_check
runs_code_review_identity_check.value:
(
        (
          "runs"."workflow_discipline" = 'code_review'
          AND "runs"."code_review_operation" IN ('repository_review', 'pull_request_review', 'finding_fix')
          AND "runs"."code_review_context" IS NOT NULL
          AND "runs"."code_review_context"->>'operation' = "runs"."code_review_operation"
          AND "runs"."compliance_framework_key" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "runs"."workflow_discipline" <> 'code_review'
          AND "runs"."code_review_operation" IS NULL
          AND "runs"."code_review_context" IS NULL
        )
      )

automations_compliance_framework_check.name: automations_compliance_framework_check
automations_compliance_framework_check.value:
(
        ("automations"."workflow_discipline" = 'pentest' AND "automations"."compliance_framework_key" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("automations"."workflow_discipline" = 'compliance' AND "automations"."compliance_framework_key" IN ('soc2', 'gdpr', 'hipaa', 'pci_dss', 'iso27001', 'nist_csf'))
      )
